CV.subject: CV
CV.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building web and mobile apps for clients and teams. I lead frontend projects using React, Next.js, React Native, and Expo, with a focus on clean UI, smooth UX, responsive design, accessibility, and user-friendly products. I also enjoy contributing to open-source projects and working remotely as a digital nomad, collaborating with teams and clients from anywhere in the world.

Own the technical roadmap, sprint planning, and architecture decisions
Mentor junior developers and run code reviews
Build and maintain the shared component library and internal design system
Ship companion mobile apps with React Native and Expo

freelance.name: Freelance

Handle client communication and delivery timelines on every project
